archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (with Archetype 4 Swiss & High-Contrast elements)
atmosphere: Sovereign, restrained, architectural, Atlantic institutional. Cinematic pacing. No SaaS UI, no dashboards, no crypto visuals.

headlines.usage: H1, H2, large editorial pull quotes. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter. Use font-light or regular.

body.usage: Paragraphs, navigation, secondary text. Use leading-relaxed. Highly legible.

data_overlays.usage: Intelligence overlays, metric counters, node labels, technical metadata.

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32. The layout should feel architectural and vast.
layout_strategy.structure: 7 connected spatial environments. Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to pin sections and crossfade them, creating the illusion of moving through rooms rather than scrolling down a page.
layout_strategy.alignment: Editorial. Avoid 'center-everything'. Use split layouts (text on left, image/3D on right or vice versa).
layout_strategy.navigation: Fixed institutional nav. Transitions from transparent to frosted glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-harbor_navy/60) on scroll. Includes 'ACCESS PORTAL' button.

motion_guidelines.scroll_engine: Lenis for smooth scrolling. Cinematic slow scroll (0.6 - 0.8x equivalent).
motion_guidelines.animations: GSAP ScrollTrigger for pinning and section transitions. Framer Motion for text reveals and micro-interactions.
motion_guidelines.style: Opacity fades, atmospheric dissolves, slow y-axis translates. NO bounces, NO springs. Motion must feel controlled, calm, expensive, confident.
motion_guidelines.rooster_animation: A 3D hand-drawn animated silhouette of a rooster. Single solid color with visible lines. Walks across the lower foreground during section transitions. Use Framer Motion or GSAP to translate it horizontally based on scroll progress.

environments.description: Full-viewport hero, cinematic Ken Burns zoom on architectural background, large editorial headline, elegant CTA.
Editorial split layout. 3 sequential pillar reveals driven by scroll. Intelligence overlays in JetBrains Mono.
Full-dark environment. Three.js particle system (Nexus ENV 03) with 3 ambient nodes.
ZephyrTrustAI gateway. Animated metrics counters, institutional copy. Link to external platform.
Metallic dark palette (#1C1C1C + #7A8B94). 3 infrastructure node reveals, JetBrains Mono labels.
Editorial portrait. Chronicle Display pull quote. Pedigree stats.
Minimal dark atlantic horizon. 'INQUIRE PRIVATELY' CTA, highly customized raw HTML/Tailwind contact form.

limestone_atrium.description: White concrete building atrium, used for ENV 01 Main Hall hero background with a slow Ken Burns effect.

limestone_atrium_chairs.description: Minimal architectural space, used for ENV 02 Advisory Chamber.

editorial_portrait.description: Man in dark suit, used for ENV 06 Founder Chamber portrait.

dark_atlantic_ocean.description: Dark ocean horizon, used for ENV 07 Exit Horizon background.

rooster_silhouette.description: Hand-drawn wireframe rooster silhouette. To be animated across the lower foreground during transitions using Framer Motion.

component_rules.forms: Do not use generic Shadcn form UI. Build custom raw Tailwind inputs with minimal borders (border-b only) in Atlantic Sand/Brass color. Focus states should be subtle opacity shifts, no thick rings.
component_rules.buttons: Custom rectangular buttons. Avoid standard rounded-md. Use tracking-widest for button text.
component_rules.overlays: Use JetBrains Mono. Position absolute with brackets like [ LATITUDE : 24.5 ] to give a technical institutional feel.
component_rules.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

tech_stack_instructions.three_js: Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei for ENV 03 Nexus Reveal. Create a slow-moving, elegant particle network in Ivory and Atlantic Sand.
tech_stack_instructions.gsap: Install gsap. Use ScrollTrigger to pin sections and scrub opacity/y-transforms.
tech_stack_instructions.framer_motion: Use framer-motion for simple presence/entry animations and the rooster walk cycle.
tech_stack_instructions.lenis: Install @studio-freight/lenis or lenis for smooth scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the cinematic feel.
tech_stack_instructions.lucide: Use lucide-react for minimal iconography. Use thin stroke widths (1px or 1.5px).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a cinematic, single-page scroll experience. Do not build standard routing pages. All environments live on one route, stacked and pinned via GSAP.
Install the required libraries: gsap, framer-motion, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, lenis.
Ensure global CSS exports the design tokens as sawyer-theme.css / sawyer-tokens.json as variables.
Enforce 'prefers-reduced-motion' checks where possible, but default to the smooth cinematic experience.
For the Rooster, absolute position the image at the bottom of the viewport with fixed positioning during scroll, translating its X position based on ScrollTrigger progress.
